verdict.rationale: The pack only shows Entra ID can route activity/audit logs to external endpoints via diagnostic settings (e.g., Event Hubs) for downstream consumption, which offers a form of near-real-time event streaming, but no evidence describes an explicit webhook/event-hook subscription API (e.g., Graph change notifications) tied specifically to user lifecycle or auth events. Missing for 10: documented webhook/subscription API for lifecycle/auth events, real-time push mechanism, and developer-facing event schema/examples.
